name: Test of Lore
summary: Across the Great Sea, Horde seekers now carry the Test of Lore to the ruins of Lordaeron. You have answered Braug Dimspirit's first riddle in the Stonetalon Mountains. Now he sends you to a former human scholar among the Forsaken in Undercity.

sections.title: A Scholarly Alliance
sections.body: After you prove your mettle and learn the Dragon Aspects' history in the Legacy of the Aspects, Braug Dimspirit admits his knowledge has limits. The trial now reaches beyond Kalimdor and shows the Horde's far-reaching ties. So Braug sends you toward the undead capital beneath the ruins of Lordaeron.

sections.title: The Sceptical Historian
sections.body: Parqual Fintallas lives in the damp corridors of the Apothecarium. Once a respected human chronicler of the northern kingdoms, he kept seeking knowledge through the Scourge and his transformation into one of the Forsaken. You arrive as an outsider, claiming to have completed the spiritual and physical trials of Thousand Needles. Parqual doubts you are more than an opportunistic mercenary, and expects you to prove your worth to him.

faq.q: Why does a tauren trial send me all the way to Undercity?
faq.answer: Braug Dimspirit knows mastering lore means learning more than Kalimdor's history. He sends you to Parqual Fintallas, a renowned human scholar whose knowledge survived Lordaeron's fall and his transformation into undeath. Parqual will test your understanding of world history.

faq.q: Where exactly is Parqual Fintallas located?
faq.answer: Parqual Fintallas is in Undercity, along the southern bridge in the Apothecarium quarter.

faq.q: Who was Parqual Fintallas in life?
faq.answer: In life, Parqual Fintallas was an accomplished human historian in the kingdom of Lordaeron. The Plague of Undeath claimed him, and he joined Sylvanas's Forsaken. He kept studying, turning his intellect to darker inquiries.

faq.q: Why doesn't Parqual believe Braug sent me?
faq.answer: Parqual distrusts outsiders. He cannot believe an ordinary adventurer could leap from Thousand Needles' spires, defeat primeval elementals, and retrieve ancient relics. He suspects you only overheard tavern rumors.

faq.q: What larger trial is this quest part of?
faq.answer: The Test of Lore grew from the trial Dorn Plainstalker began at the Weathered Nook, and this is its midpoint. It tests combat prowess, courage, intellect, and historical knowledge worthy of a Horde champion.

faq.q: What comes next after reaching Parqual?
faq.answer: Parqual will ask his own historical riddle only after you undertake an errand for him in the Eastern Kingdoms. He wants proof that you are the capable hero Braug claims you to be.

angles.text: Meeting Parqual shows how Forsaken scholars like him kept the academic traditions and records of fallen Lordaeron despite rot and undeath.
As a tauren initiate, you leave Kalimdor's open plains and high mesas for Undercity's poisonous, cramped sewers. The journey tests your understanding of another culture as well as history.
The Test of Lore reveals the ties between the newly forged Horde's peoples. It brings tauren seekers together with Lordaeron's grim archivists.
